## Section II Part B

### Paragraph Ordering

```exam-item
{
  "unitKey": "synthetic_kaoyan_2026_part_b_1",
  "type": "paragraph_ordering",
  "displayTitle": "Part B",
  "slots": [41, 42, 43],
  "fixed": [
    { "position": 0, "candidateKey": "A" },
    { "position": 4, "candidateKey": "E" }
  ],
  "answerSequence": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
```

#### Candidate A
This fixed paragraph opens the story by introducing the research question.
It must remain in the first position.

#### Candidate B
The second paragraph explains the method used by the researchers.
It describes participants and the controlled reading experiment.

#### Candidate C
The third paragraph presents the main results and compares the two groups.
It reports the observed improvement in retention.

#### Candidate D
The fourth paragraph discusses the implications for classroom practice.
It suggests shorter daily sessions over longer weekly reviews.

#### Candidate E
This fixed paragraph closes the passage with a summary and future research direction.
It must remain in the final position.
